subject: Updated bus plan
text: The bus situation worked out better than expected. The driver we first asked for is covering another school event, but her colleague agreed to join if we meet at the community center instead of the depot. I spoke with him at 9:20. He can pick up the volunteers there, drop us at the site, and return after the closing session. No extra fee is needed. I asked about the luggage limit because of the banner and first-aid kit, and he said the rear compartment will fit everything. I am sending the updated schedule to the volunteers now and will bring printed copies tomorrow. Please confirm whether you want to ride with us or meet at the site. The extra seats also let you review the checklist, assign the folders, and settle any seating concerns before arrival at the venue.
